item.title: Reliability Assessment under High IBR Penetration
item.description:
Stochastic, probabilistic frameworks that quantify reliability and resource-adequacy metrics for grids dominated by inverter-based resources. Part of the NSF project “Enhancing Grid Reliability and Stability with Distributed Energy Resources” (Award #2321661).

Related work: “Survey of Reliability Challenges and Assessment in Power Grids with High Penetration of Inverter-Based Resources,” Energies, 2024.

item.title: Resilience of Distribution and Interdependent Infrastructure
item.description:
Stochastic infrastructure damage evaluation with fragility curves and network reduction, resilience enhancement of distribution systems by remote-controlled switch placement, and resilience of the electricity–water–transportation nexus with last-mile solar relief pack delivery.

Related work: IEEE Transactions on Power Delivery (2024) and manuscripts under review at IEEE Transactions on Reliability and IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid.
